name: Shirakawa Tsuguo
source:
Ichiri's younger brother by two two years. He entered a school in a neighboring prefecture as a soccer scholarship student and lives in a dormitory away from home. Tsuguo is an honest, cheeky and energetic boy who has a tendency to be swayed by others. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050407195831/http://zui.co.jp/products/kashoku/kashoku.html]official website[/url].]
